findings.explanation: The detailed implementation consists entirely of generic template boilerplate without specific instructions for MySQL InnoDB status metric polling.
findings.quote: Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=mysql:status into database. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide concrete DB Connect inputs.conf stanzas or scripted polling configuration for MySQL global status queries.

summary: Impacted by title salad descriptions, generic template scaffolding, and entirely boilerplate detailed implementation text.
